market_summary: During the London session, markets display mixed consolidation without high-volume catalysts. XAUUSD is staging a weak counter-trend bounce after an extended selloff, while EURUSD and GBPUSD consolidate near session highs inside their respective Value Areas with subdued RVOL. BTCUSD remains compressed in a structural downtrend below VWAP and VAL, lacking expansion volume. All pairs warrant a patient HOLD.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3969.92) and below POC (3978.28), trading in a severe downtrend. CVD is -3.14 (BEARISH) matching the overall negative trend, although short-term cvd_slope is positive showing a minor relief bounce. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades well below both VWAP (3972.12) and EMA50 (3970.44), both sloping downward. Candles recently bounced from the lower ATR band and Session Low (3924.30), but are now pulling back right into the EMA20 baseline (3953.43) without yellow RVOL confirmation (rvol_last 0.601). With resistance overhead at S/R 3968.55 and no clean setup at the current mid-rebound price, a disciplined HOLD is warranted.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection of session low bounce into EMA20

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10773, VAH 1.10981) and trading directly at POC (1.10946). CVD is +5311.71 (BULLISH) with a strongly positive slope (+4660.67), aligning with the intraday recovery. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding firmly above VWAP (1.10850) and EMA50 (1.10883). ATR bands are contracting and candles are pushing against the upper ATR band (1.10977). However, RVOL is only 0.824 (no yellow spike) as price approaches heavy resistance at Session High (1.10988) and S/R (1.11007). Buying directly into the upper Value Area boundary without a confirmed breakout volume spike carries high risk of a mean-reversion rejection back to POC/VWAP; therefore, HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish holding above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance above POC testing Session High

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593, VAH 1.32797) hovering just below POC (1.32738). CVD is -1338.79 (NEUTRAL) with a modest positive slope (+1406.59), showing lack of clear directional delta divergence or conviction. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price sits above VWAP (1.32663) and EMA50 (1.32696). ATR channel is expanding modestly, with price tracking between the EMA20 baseline and the upper ATR band (1.32800). RVOL is low at 0.761 (no yellow bars), and price is compressing tightly below Session High (1.32809). Mid-value-area chop without volume confirmation calls for a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish holding above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance near POC under Session High

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (73397.14) and below POC (73541.61), indicating value acceptance in lower territory. CVD is -0.04 (BEARISH) with flat/negative delta slope, agreeing with the prevailing downward structure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price remains capped below both VWAP (73612.03) and EMA50 (73618.59). ATR is contracting, with candles consolidating in the lower half of the ATR channel. Recent signal candle closed weak at 73314.0 below local S/R (73386.80), and the forming bar is testing into S/R resistance near EMA20 (73446.84) on low volume (RVOL 1.171, no yellow spikes). Lack of dynamic momentum and proximate support at 73284.60 and Session Low (73166.00) makes initiating a short suboptimal; maintain HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below descending VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection at S/R and EMA20 baseline
